ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #9
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on brushing teeth? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Hadith on brushing teeth with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on brushing teeth.
   C. Say Hadith on brushing teeth has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Hadith on brushing teeth to insult classmates of other faiths.

2. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Hiding stolen items
   B. Spreading rumours
   C. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   D. Cheating in exams

3. Which response best shows understanding of Twahara Types of Najasaat? (1 mark)
   A. Say Twahara Types of Najasaat has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Twahara Types of Najasaat to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Twahara Types of Najasaat with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Twahara Types of Najasaat.

4. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith of Prophet Muhammad as a model of good character.? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Hadith of Prophet Muhammad as a model of good character. with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Hadith of Prophet Muhammad as a model of good character. to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Hadith of Prophet Muhammad as a model of good character. has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith of Prophet Muhammad as a model of good character..

5. Which response best shows understanding of Attributes of Allah? (1 mark)
   A. Use Attributes of Allah to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Attributes of Allah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Attributes of Allah.
   D. Say Attributes of Allah has no place in daily life.

6. Which response best shows understanding of Prophets mentioned in the Qur’an Virtues of the Prophets (patience, honesty, tru? (1 mark)
   A. Say Prophets mentioned in the Qur’an Virtues of the Prophets (patience, honesty, tru has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Prophets mentioned in the Qur’an Virtues of the Prophets (patience, honesty, tru to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Prophets mentioned in the Qur’an Virtues of the Prophets (patience, honesty, tru with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Prophets mentioned in the Qur’an Virtues of the Prophets (patience, honesty, tru.

7. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   B. Refusing to help a neighbour
   C. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   D. Skipping all moral lessons

8. Which response best shows understanding of Pillars of Swalah? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Pillars of Swalah.
   B. Apply the teaching of Pillars of Swalah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say Pillars of Swalah has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Pillars of Swalah to insult classmates of other faiths.

9. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Destroy trees without planting
   B. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   C. Pollute rivers deliberately
   D. Waste food daily

10. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on Etiquette of Eating? (1 mark)
   A. Use Hadith on Etiquette of Eating to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Hadith on Etiquette of Eating with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on Etiquette of Eating.
   D. Say Hadith on Etiquette of Eating has no place in daily life.

11. Which response best shows understanding of Wudhu? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Wudhu with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Wudhu to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Wudhu has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Wudhu.

12. Which response best shows understanding of Belief in Angels Atid,? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Belief in Angels Atid,.
   B. Use Belief in Angels Atid, to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Belief in Angels Atid, has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Belief in Angels Atid, with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Children’s Obligations to Other Family Members and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Call to prophet hood 03 7.2 Earliest coverts to Islam 04 7.3 Prophets journey Ta and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Call to Prophethood and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Prophets journey Taif 03 TOTAL 90 Page 12 of 63 1 and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
